scope: Planning assumptions only, not observed precision or power. N is independent participants with complete paired scores.
limitations: Normal approximation ignores finite-sample t correction and attrition.
Paired difference is in [-8,8], so SD <=8 is a conservative bound; SD=2 is unverified.
No effect-size assumption or statement that any N guarantees significance.
Task-root diversity requires its own evidence; increasing participant N does not create independent root causes.
